To set up your listing, visit the [Google Business Profile Creation Page](https://business.google.com/create) or go to [Google Business Profile](https://business.google.com/en-all/business-profile/) and follow these steps:[[1]](https://business.google.com/en-all/business-profile/)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXOoDUDXRsC02xFUKNAE4YufKNfgDAmidPvQvEYA_NVgCJjBUFz-NrYIFlGdjzOKXJqQk_f-tXKUT4i-G38jFz0XSTZqBDPunZTh6vvNFHSpwB2wGOzEXGfTDNGzpd6zsh8mzQrH4ulNhKtR_ugqL3lA9aAM2LEok)[[3]](https://business.google.com/create)[[4]](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2911778?hl=en)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)

### Step-by-Step Setup

- **Sign in:** Log in with the Google Account you want to use to manage your business (preferably a dedicated business email rather than a personal one).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWHJf0QRbOTNRYpbQRmorST_cSDq_yDIRv3TCM4cT2gqdLRbQrAHkIyrPPn5BiLBQ-Tm4iNmmEegXvkiWpY-zZmb8Yo3bY8TvGEpSVBNCYtaH7KMohd_njRBiZmXA4mSV0dvQNPIRbwKij7bn82D7hpTbEr-lau4)
- **Enter your business name:** Type your official business name. If a profile already appears, click to **claim** it. If it does not exist, select **Add your business to Google**.[[1]](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2911778?hl=en)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWHJf0QRbOTNRYpbQRmorST_cSDq_yDIRv3TCM4cT2gqdLRbQrAHkIyrPPn5BiLBQ-Tm4iNmmEegXvkiWpY-zZmb8Yo3bY8TvGEpSVBNCYtaH7KMohd_njRBiZmXA4mSV0dvQNPIRbwKij7bn82D7hpTbEr-lau4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXiov3fWBBfbQoQjQZZd3G9nlfyXgA-Cu9dxXD-auuEdvOug4P9lQQzuafPFMpT8L_EBOSrb01e9WkOQjfUcELtK5-RPjNMGZ5ZNAJB3385Pf7NFjtRnu66YsG3KiUEU3GAk7xYpoZFhA)
- **Choose your business type:** Select whether your business is a **local store** (customers visit you), a **service business** (you go to them), or **online retail**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXiov3fWBBfbQoQjQZZd3G9nlfyXgA-Cu9dxXD-auuEdvOug4P9lQQzuafPFMpT8L_EBOSrb01e9WkOQjfUcELtK5-RPjNMGZ5ZNAJB3385Pf7NFjtRnu66YsG3KiUEU3GAk7xYpoZFhA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)
- **Select your category:** Pick a primary category that best describes your core product or service (be as specific as possible).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWHJf0QRbOTNRYpbQRmorST_cSDq_yDIRv3TCM4cT2gqdLRbQrAHkIyrPPn5BiLBQ-Tm4iNmmEegXvkiWpY-zZmb8Yo3bY8TvGEpSVBNCYtaH7KMohd_njRBiZmXA4mSV0dvQNPIRbwKij7bn82D7hpTbEr-lau4)
- **Add location or service areas:** Enter your physical business address if you have a storefront. If you operate without a public storefront, list the towns, cities, or regions you serve.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX-qoi-80QLPCACKxXU-Jhvo4Xaj9x6Zeqm759WGdX5Vdyf2XiPUT1W_ZUKQynDDiWdDMFuLJRaDSzm2fm-RPXFu-05c8HqBYe-wjMizwbTtjNAK81rylKkUpQmVA0_RMBoJUxTSi725_Z)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXiov3fWBBfbQoQjQZZd3G9nlfyXgA-Cu9dxXD-auuEdvOug4P9lQQzuafPFMpT8L_EBOSrb01e9WkOQjfUcELtK5-RPjNMGZ5ZNAJB3385Pf7NFjtRnu66YsG3KiUEU3GAk7xYpoZFhA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXfGvzyUMfv-mfRB3FJoV-b8mGjUhClcqPJk-844q-e-JfM3rZxVQiIkylS7388cUes7eDjbuYi1XPjUUbo1gJNIqeXcNvs45uvMDPwKUrtbZwqS6xvp0k-1BF3SpyDSAeq_5ctFkig-1L)
- **Provide contact details:** Add your main business phone number and website URL.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWHJf0QRbOTNRYpbQRmorST_cSDq_yDIRv3TCM4cT2gqdLRbQrAHkIyrPPn5BiLBQ-Tm4iNmmEegXvkiWpY-zZmb8Yo3bY8TvGEpSVBNCYtaH7KMohd_njRBiZmXA4mSV0dvQNPIRbwKij7bn82D7hpTbEr-lau4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)
- **Verify your business:** Complete verification to make your profile live on Google Search and Maps. Google typically offers verification via phone call, email, video recording proof, or a postcard with a PIN code.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXjflfebIZO5-5Wa8EAbE8cDZ5PKGxhJxNG6m6cLWdAhjc_hENlg1YicB2Zvto4piJ6w3Qsga8zZltSr3pnpvFcQ5S8X_zCK1VzfOPntedDfd1WdYAeWMkBDoX_jCFA35Gl7GCUvSwIJE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX3yTwIfXULPVSSrvEFo9jByB-07HlvnUfEGC7uEqx76_pZL2Zv6WjipGr0DYGnOFtTJh0opN15FMAUdnAull44LgNtnxh29CMyZWQ-OOG4So3eCquUMJdQDTRLBUQuXIUWgoRM7c_Bttn)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXP9c5fI5yeDMi5WnqaR-KnbQxDMVHvelKVk5MFZYyp-pn1OxwzgVK1BgpCZ8Zd6Pfeu5zoLL-nLM9NLDAnIH2FU9eBj6vUIRyvyzJ0usC39Zn4v3aqQNozUFZlAzOFb8oKhQ)
- **Optimize your profile:** Add your operating hours, a detailed business description (up to 750 characters), services offered, and high-quality exterior/interior or product photos.[[1]](https://business.google.com/en-all/business-profile/)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wjF-3g_TgE_24rreKYRiajp5_W6o2ww_lkxNEFGRF0HpjtB_05Gq5FeZ40CaFtHM2yXBz7uomnGz_11MxpEZWI02v-97D8p0xPmixwHYhGhSaBoyJ9T82FYn9gMgm1rvEnFr_Xj4nhBXZ9agisIhL_krI8nc6Dus1PNQgq3TysiBZKwP5E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXiov3fWBBfbQoQjQZZd3G9nlfyXgA-Cu9dxXD-auuEdvOug4P9lQQzuafPFMpT8L_EBOSrb01e9WkOQjfUcELtK5-RPjNMGZ5ZNAJB3385Pf7NFjtRnu66YsG3KiUEU3GAk7xYpoZFhA)

If you'd like help, tell me:

- What **type of business** you run
- Whether you have a **physical storefront** or work from home/service areas

I can help you pick the best category and write your business description.
